# OxyLux Solutions

> OxyLux Solutions is a clinic in Hialeah, Florida, opening November 2, 2026. It offers hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) in a modern Oxycell OxyPro Genesis hard-shell chamber, IV therapy, massage therapy, infrared therapy, Venus Legacy and Botox. Spanish is spoken. The Founder and Medical Director is Dr. Fermin Morales, MD, FACS.

- Address: 14361 Commerce Way, Suite 201, Hialeah, FL 33016, United States
- Phone: (305) 205-2738
- Email: frontdesk@oxyluxsolutions.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM (Eastern). Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Booking: online at https://www.oxyluxsolutions.com/reserve (choose a time and service, then sign that service's consent form), or by phone
- Insurance: most major plans accepted for eligible services; coverage depends on the plan and diagnosis. Cosmetic services are usually not covered.
